color_palette_source: Derived from Omani flag colors (red, white, green) adapted for premium business aesthetic - deep navy for trust/professionalism, warm gold for premium/Omani heritage, cream for elegant backgrounds

imagery_style.description: High-end product photography of NFC cards on premium surfaces (marble, wood, leather), lifestyle shots of professionals networking in Omani settings (Muscat Corniche, Al Mouj, OCEC), clean studio shots with dramatic lighting showing card materials and finishes
imagery_style.photo_treatment: Natural lighting, subtle shadows, premium feel, consistent color grading
imagery_style.composition: Clean, uncluttered, product-focused with contextual lifestyle

layout_notes.hero: Full-screen hero with animated card showcase, subtle parallax, CTA above fold
layout_notes.sections: Generous whitespace, card-based layouts, staggered reveal animations
layout_notes.cards: Elevated cards with soft shadows, hover lift effects, glassmorphism accents
layout_notes.buttons: Primary: navy with gold accent, Secondary: gold outline, Ghost: navy text
layout_notes.dividers: Subtle gold lines, geometric Omani pattern accents
layout_notes.backgrounds: Cream base with subtle geometric patterns, occasional navy sections for contrast

identity_notes: Brand identity inferred from username, Oman market context, and competitor analysis. Actual Instagram profile visuals not directly accessible. Colors chosen to reflect: 1) Deep navy (#0D2B5E) for corporate trust and premium positioning, 2) Warm gold (#C8A951) for Omani heritage and premium feel, 3) Cream (#FDFBF7) for elegant minimal backgrounds. This aligns with successful Omani brands like Koroot, Cardify, and Bank Muscat's visual language.
